name: Neon Snake
shortDescription: Classic snake in a neon grid: eat orbs, grow, survive.
description: Neon Snake brings the arcade classic into a glowing retro grid. Guide a bright green serpent with arrow keys, WASD or a swipe, collect pulsing energy orbs and watch your tail grow with every bite. The pace rises in steps: each five orbs unlock a faster level, so the safe routes close in and every turn matters. A seeded generator makes each run reproducible for platform verification while keeping the layout fresh for players. The HUD shows your score, level and progress toward the next speed-up, and the game-over board confirms your place, personal best and the top ten. Short rounds, crisp neon feedback, full keyboard and touch controls, six interface languages and a guest-friendly flow make it an easy break-time challenge. The game never asks for registration and never sends you away from the play field.
instructions: Eat the glowing orb to score and grow. Each five orbs raises the level and speed. Avoid the walls and your own tail. Press pause whenever you need a break.
controls: Desktop: arrow keys or W A S D, P or Escape to pause. Mobile: swipe on the field or use the on-screen pad.
